name: Result notice (4 parts)

next_step.abnormal-generic: see a primary-care doctor or go to your referral
next_step.fit-positive: have a colonoscopy (a repeat stool test is not enough)
next_step.bp-elevated: have your blood pressure measured again on another day
next_step.cervical-abnormal: see a clinician for a follow-up check
next_step.new-symptoms: talk to a health worker about your symptoms

next_step.abnormal-generic: magpatingin sa doktor sa primary care o pumunta sa iyong referral
next_step.fit-positive: magpa-colonoscopy (hindi sapat ang pag-ulit ng stool test)
next_step.bp-elevated: ipasukat muli ang iyong presyon ng dugo sa ibang araw
next_step.cervical-abnormal: magpatingin sa clinician para sa follow-up na pagsusuri
next_step.new-symptoms: kausapin ang isang health worker tungkol sa iyong mga sintomas

en.what_happened: Your recent {screening_name} result needs a follow-up step.
en.what_it_does_not_mean: This is not a diagnosis. It means a health worker needs to check further.
en.what_to_do_next: Next step: {next_step}. Please do this by {due_date}. We can help you book.
en.when_to_seek_urgent_help: If you feel very unwell or have new or severe symptoms, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room now. Clinic: {clinic_phone}.

fil.what_happened: Ang resulta ng iyong {screening_name} kamakailan ay nangangailangan ng susunod na hakbang.
fil.what_it_does_not_mean: Hindi ito diagnosis. Ibig sabihin nito, kailangan pang suriin ng isang health worker.
fil.what_to_do_next: Susunod na hakbang: {next_step}. Pakigawa ito bago ang {due_date}. Matutulungan ka naming mag-book.
fil.when_to_seek_urgent_help: Kung masama ang pakiramdam mo o may bago o matinding sintomas, tumawag sa 911 o pumunta agad sa pinakamalapit na emergency room. Klinika: {clinic_phone}.

review_note: Pending clinical review and native Filipino speaker review. Not yet approved for real patients.
